description: November 21 birthday meaning: Scorpio or Sagittarius cusp, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, November 21 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Scorpio or Sagittarius. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The November 21 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: November 21 sits on the Scorpio–Sagittarius cusp, so the Sun sign depends on year and time of birth, though most years place it in the late twenties of Scorpio. The blend pairs depth with optimism, privacy with candour. The birthday number 3 adds wit and sociability, often producing someone who can be intensely serious one moment and riotously funny the next.

Astronomically, November 21 puts the Sun near 28° Scorpio in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Moon. Around November 21 to November 23, the Sun crosses from Scorpio into Sagittarius, from depth into distance. If you were born then, your Sun sign is settled by year, time and place, because the boundary shifts by roughly a day between years; a natal chart calculated for your birth is the reliable check. People who relate to both signs are often described as intense adventurers: they want to understand something fully and then go somewhere new with what they have learned. Honesty tends to be a shared value, sometimes delivered with considerable force.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 21
paragraphs: Born on the 21st, your compound reduces as 2 + 1 = 3. Unlike the 12th, where the individual comes first, here the 2 of partnership leads and the 1 follows, which numerologists sometimes read as creativity that grows out of relationships. The resulting 3 is expressive, social and optimistic. Twenty-first-born people are often described as charming and versatile, able to bring people together and make collaborative projects enjoyable. As a supporting number, the 21 tends to show in how easily they connect. Seeing a shared project through to the end can be their most valued contribution.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 21 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 21 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 21 is the 325th day of the year (326th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Sagittarius, is usually complete within 2 days, by November 23.

By November 21 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 21 birthday are Benedict XV (1854), Björk (1965) and René Magritte (1898).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 21?
faq.answer: November 21 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Scorpio or Sagittarius on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Scorpio. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 21?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 21 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 21st.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 21?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 21, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 21?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 21 include Benedict XV (1854), Björk (1965) and René Magritte (1898). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
